state.instructions: Go to the shop, find a blue sweatshirt, select size large, and get the price. Never add anything to the bag and never open the checkout. Stop once the price of a blue sweatshirt in size large has been read.

tactic.instructions: Which action best advances `instructions`, given `state.screen`, `state.judgments` and `state.done`?

criteria.open_menu: Point at an entry in the row of menus at the top of the page, so that a menu opens under it. Right on the front page of a site when what `instructions` ask for is not visible yet and no menu is open.
criteria.pick_menu_entry: Click the entry of the open menu that leads to what `instructions` ask for. Right when a menu is open.
criteria.scroll: Scroll down to bring more of this page into view. Right only on a list of items, when what `instructions` ask for is not visible in it yet and the list goes on below.
criteria.filter: Narrow a list of items with its filters (a Filter or Colour control, in a side bar or above the items), so that items of the kind that `instructions` ask for are shown. Right on a list that offers filters, when that item is not visible in it.
criteria.click_item: Click the item that `instructions` ask for in a list of items, to open its own page. Right when that item is visible in a list.
criteria.select_option: Choose the option that `instructions` ask for (a size, a colour) on the page of one item. Right on an item's page when that option is not chosen yet.
criteria.read_value: Read the value that `instructions` ask to get (a price, a number) from the page. Right when that value is visible and the options `instructions` ask for are chosen.
criteria.go_back: Go back to the previous page. Right when this page does not lead to what `instructions` ask for.
criteria.close_overlay: Close what is in the way (a pop-up, a banner, a notice).
criteria.end: Stop, because `instructions` have been carried out according to `state.done`.
